speaker: OpenSLR SLR83 East London Male (2484, CC-BY-SA-4.0)

welcome_pips.text: Awright mate! I'm Trev — click any bed to grab the arrows. See those eight little brass dots top-left? Light all eight with clean shots to unlock each level's Pub Trial and win your Brass Stars!

first_pip.text: Nice one, mate! That's your first brass pip lit up top-left. Seven more clean shots unlocks the Pub Trial — keep those arrows flying!

eight_pips.text: Eight out of eight pips in the bag, pal! Hit Take Trial up top whenever you're ready to go for your Brass Stars!

sub_trick_intro.text: Quick chalker's trick, mate: don't wrestle with big numbers in your head! Knock a clean hundred off first, then chuck the spare back on — hit Tab if you want me to hop the slate for ya.

sound_on.text: Wahey, sound's up! Hear the regulars chatting and the jukebox in the corner? Proper East End boozer now, mate.

voice_on.text: Awright mate, Trev's loud and clear — let's put some arrows in the board!

voice_cockney_demo.text: Awright mate! Proper East End Trev on the mic now — grab your arrows and let's get some trebles in the lipstick!

stage_cal.text: Twelve quick arrows across Levels one to six so I can see where you're sharp and where you need a hand. Don't overthink it — just throw natural, mate!

stage_1.text: Level one, mate — gotta know your doubles in your sleep! Hit the double I call, or tell me what a lit double's worth. Keep an eye on twenty down to fifteen and their neighbors!

stage_2.text: Level two — trebles all round the clock! Hit the treble or call the score fast. Twenty down to fifteen pop up most, and don't let treble fourteen being forty-two mug you off!

stage_3.text: Level three — proper pub chalking! Three darts land together. Stop counting one by one like it's primary school — snap two easy darts first, then slap the third one on!

stage_4.text: Level four — three-oh-one chalk and countdown! Throw your three arrows, add the visit, then take it off the slate in clean round hops. Fast chalk widens your aim bars!

stage_5.text: Level five — two-dart finishes! Below-sixty setup tricks, the Golden Forty-Four using your twenty-five, thirty, thirty-five pairs with no peeking, plus Sod's Law recoveries!

stage_6.text: Level six — ton-plus outs! Drop the one, add forty for treble twenty or forty-three for treble nineteen, dodge the sneaky splash traps, and keep well clear of those bogey numbers!

stage_7.text: Championship five-oh-one, mate! Double out, chalk your own arrows, mark your rival on the slate, and remember — I'm watching every single board-management call like a hawk!

praise_01.text: Oh, that's filthy — bang in the lipstick, mate!

praise_02.text: Tidy arrow, pal — sweet as a nut!

praise_03.text: Go on then! Making it look easy now.

praise_04.text: Spot on, mate — didn't even blink!

praise_05.text: Look at that grouping — proper pub league stuff, pal!

praise_06.text: Even Big Dave's gone quiet over by the fruit machine!

praise_07.text: Right on the button, mate — lovely stuff!

praise_08.text: Who needs a warm-up when you're throwing like that?!

praise_09.text: Clean as a whistle, pal — keep that arm nice and loose!

praise_10.text: That dart had eyes on it, mate — class!

praise_11.text: Boom! Straight in the paint, no messing about.

praise_12.text: Tell you what, mate, you've definitely had your Weetabix today!

praise_13.text: Smooth as a fresh pint of bitter, pal!

praise_14.text: Dead center, mate — the spider wire didn't even flinch!

streak_3a.text: Three on the spin — hang on, who are you and what have you done with my student? Keep 'em flying!

streak_3b.text: Three in a row, mate! Starting to make me look like a proper darts coach now!

pint_classic.text: Blimey, mate, you are so accurate I'd let you have a go at knocking this off — except I don't want to part with a perfectly good pint!

pint_london.text: Five on the spin! I'd balance my pint on my head for ya — if it weren't six quid a pop in London! Tidy throwing, mate!

pint_tab.text: Five clean shots in a row! Keep this up and I'm putting you on the pub team — first round's on the house, pal!

streak_8a.text: Leave it out, pal! You're making treble twenty look like a dinner plate — Ally Pally's gonna be ringing your mobile in a minute!

streak_8b.text: Proper Bobby Dazzler, mate! Even the blokes by the fruit machine have stopped playing to watch you throw!

streak_8c.text: Are you having a laugh?! Eight straight — someone check his arrows, they've got magnets in 'em!

tonplus_1.text: Boom! Ton-plus checkout, clean as a whistle — I'm getting the next round in, mate!

tonplus_2.text: Proper diamond finish, pal! Collapsed three digits without even breaking a sweat.

tonplus_3.text: Look at that checkout, mate — ice in your veins! Proper match-winner!

ton_big_1.text: Lovely ton-plus visit, mate — you're throwing arrows like a machine!

ton_big_2.text: Heavy scoring, pal! That'll make 'em sweat over by the bar!

miss_01.text: Clang! Kissed the spider wire, mate — shake it off and stick the next one in.

miss_02.text: Ooh, cheeky bounce-out, pal! Have a quick look and nail the next one.

miss_03.text: Unlucky, mate — that wire's thicker than a bus ticket today! Go again.

miss_04.text: Bit shy there, pal — don't worry, we'll pretend nobody at the bar saw that!

miss_05.text: Ooh, close! Right idea, mate — tighten it up a touch and it's sorted.

miss_06.text: Haha, the dartboard's fighting back a bit! Brush it off, you've got the next one.

miss_07.text: Nearly had it, mate — even the pros clip the odd wire. Reset and go again!

miss_08.text: Bit rusty on that one, pal — good job we're practising before Friday league night!

miss_09.text: Not quite, mate — keep your head up, the rhythm's coming together nicely.

miss_10.text: Ooh, harsh bounce! Have a quick breather and pop the next one straight in.

breakfast_1.text: Awright mate! Twenty-six — bed and breakfast! Toast is burnt an' all. Laugh it off, next visit's a ton.

breakfast_2.text: Full English twenty-six, pal — sausage, egg, and beans! Every pub player's favourite score. Shake it off!

breakfast_3.text: Twenty-six! Classic five, twenty, one — at least you're hitting the top of the board, mate! Go again.

breakfast_4.text: Bed and breakfast served piping hot, pal! Leave it behind ya and bang a ton in next visit.

wire_miss_1.text: Bit wide there, pal — nearly took the landlord's crisp rack out! Deep breath, next arrow's right on it.

wire_miss_2.text: Whoops, hit the black stuff for zero, mate! Mind the wallpaper — steady up and go again.

wire_miss_3.text: Just outside the double wire, pal — right postcode, wrong door! Next one's in.

wire_miss_4.text: Giving the surround a bit of wear and tear there, mate! Deep breath, bring it inside the wire.

wire_pull_1.text: Snuck into the wrong bedroom there, mate! Happens to the best of us — reset the wrist and go again.

wire_pull_2.text: Bit of a pull across the wire, pal — good news is you're still on the board. Adapt and carry on!

wire_pull_3.text: Dragged that one into the neighbor's garden, mate! Loosen the grip and straighten it up.

wire_pull_4.text: Classic pub drift into the neighbor, pal — keep your elbow still and watch it fly straight!

bust_1.text: Ooh, bust! Got a bit greedy there, didn't ya? Score goes right back — shake it off, leg's still wide open.

bust_2.text: Bust! Bit too much mustard on that dart, mate — no drama, you'll get another crack at it.

bust_3.text: Overcooked it, pal — bust! Take a sip, clear the head, and nail it next visit.

madhouse_1.text: Welcome to the Madhouse, mate — nobody wants to live on double one! Deep breath, stick it in the basement.

madhouse_2.text: Oh no, down in the Madhouse on double one! Don't panic, pal — nice soft throw, get yourself out of there!

bell_1.text: Bell beat ya, pal — even Big Dave's pint went flat waiting! No sweat, keep the next one smooth.

bell_2.text: Ding-ding, clock got ya, mate! Don't overthink it — trust your first instinct next go.

bell_3.text: Out of time, pal — the barman nearly called last orders! Shake it off, you'll get quicker every round.

flow_hot_1.text: Lightning chalking, mate! You're right in the flow now — watch your aim bars slow down and open wide!

flow_hot_2.text: Sharp as a tack on that slate, pal — you've earned yourself a massive sweet spot!

flow_cold_1.text: Clock rattled ya on the chalk, mate — head's spinning a bit, so your next throw's gonna feel tighter. Shake it off!

two_in_t20_1.text: Two in the lipstick! Shhh — whole boozer's gone quiet, mate. Don't bottle it now, stick the third one in!

two_in_t20_2.text: Two in treble twenty, pal! Hold your breath — one more arrow and the roof's coming off this pub!

trial_fail.text: Unlucky off the wire, mate — two slips in the Trial. Warm up a couple more arrows and smash it next go!

trial_nopeek.text: No peeking in a Pub Trial, pal! Put the crib sheet away — you've got this wired in!

trial_slip1.text: Clipped the wire — one slip left in this Trial, mate! Steady up, you've got this.

marking_miss_1.text: Don't count 'em one by one like it's primary school, mate! Snap the two amber darts together first, then slap the stray one on.

marking_miss_2.text: Easy on the fingers, pal! Pair up the two familiar darts first, then add the odd one on top.

trap_104.text: Whoa there, mate! With three darts on a hundred and four, treble eighteen risks stray single one — leaves a hundred and three, dead in the water! Go treble nineteen or sixteen.

trap_163.text: Blimey, no! Never chuck twenty-five on two-two-eight, two-six-eight, or three-oh-eight — leaves bogey one-six-three! Stick to single eighteen for the Big Fish.

trap_99.text: Walked straight into the ninety-nine trap, pal! Ninety-nine's the only two-digit three-darter — dodge that wire next time!

rival_180.text: Blimey, they just banged in a hundred and eighty! Hold your nerve and hit straight back, mate!

rival_26_1.text: Haha, they just ordered bed and breakfast! Step up and put 'em out of their misery, mate!

rival_26_2.text: Twenty-six from your rival! Even the barman's chuckling — go on, punish 'em now, pal!

rival_bust_1.text: Wahey, they've gone and busted! Door's wide open — step up and punish 'em!

rival_bust_2.text: Haha, they've bottled it and busted! Step up to the oche and take the leg, mate!

rival_miss_dbl_1.text: Ooh, knees are knocking at double — step up right now and nick their pint money!

rival_miss_dbl_2.text: They've left the double begging, pal! Stay cool and put this leg to bed!

rival_low.text: Heads up, mate — they're sitting on a finish! Time to show a bit of bottle.

pace_decline_slow.text: Fair play, pal — love the bottle! Let's have it then!

pace_decline_fast.text: No rush, mate — lock it in nice and steady at your own pace.

slip_big_single.text: Sod's Law, mate — dropped into the big single! Call what's left quick to keep your rhythm!

slip_stray_treble.text: Blimey, stray neighbor treble! Stay sharp — call what's left to calm the throwing arm!
